values.note: Water & electric campsite $65 a night in the regular season, $50 a night on discount weekends (before May and after late September), for 2 adults and 2 children; 6 nights get the 7th free ($390). Extra overnight guests $11-15 a night. Wooded and B-field sites are priced per person ($16 adult, $12 age 5-17). The rates page carries a 2025 pay-by date (seasonal 5% discount 'if paid in full by May 16th 2025'); read 2026-10-20.

fees.source: https://www.campcharlescampground.com/camping-rates ('campsites: water & electric ... April 28th through September 24th per night ... $65.00 / Discount weekends per night ... $50.00'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The operator's 2025 rate sheet: 'Campground season April 11th through October 18th'.

values.note: Free hot showers, laundry, country store (firewood, ice, RV supplies), propane filling, swimming pool, game room. Water is from on-site wells.

facilities.source: https://www.campcharlescampground.com/ (amenities: 'Laundry Facilities', 'Well-equipped Country Store', 'Free Hot Showers', 'Dump Station', 'Propane Filling Station') + the 2025 site map (laundry, restrooms), read 2026-10-20

values.note: No online booking engine: every 'Book Now' button leads to a reservation inquiry form; otherwise call (610) 588-0553 or email.

booking.source: https://www.campcharlescampground.com/reservation-inquiry (inquiry form) + rates page 'Book Now' links, read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees $50-65 (water & electric site; regular season vs discount weekends; rate sheet dated by a 2025 pay-by deadline), season Apr 11 - Oct 18, water + sewer (operator map legend: all numbered RV sites Full Hookup), showers/laundry/dump/store, reservation by inquiry form or phone. Not stated: electric amperage, site count (the map shows roughly 130 numbered hookup sites; the stored 138 is RV Life's), max rig length.
